evidence: Fresh static inspection of the exact recovered assembly. Behavioral summaries and method identifiers only; no original assembly or disassembly is published. These findings are not an original-game execution oracle.

rules.finding: Select rarity first: rare 10%, uncommon 25%, common 65%, then select a model in that rarity.
rules.implementation: random_potion uses the same probability weights with the expedition's independent integer RNG. Original floating-point draws and PC seeds are not reproduced.

rules.finding: The combat factory filters CanBeGeneratedInCombat; these three active models return false.
rules.implementation: Explicit combat context filters Alchemize generation without accidentally filtering victory drops while their state is still Combat.

rules.finding: Always calls the out-of-combat factory separately for each open potion slot, with null exclusions. Recovery bottles, repeated models and Entropic Brew itself are allowed even when used during combat.
rules.implementation: Preserves occupied slots and uses random_potion(state,false) for each empty slot after consuming the bottle.

rules.rule: temporary cost lifetime and X cost
rules.finding: Temporary free effects and Snecko costs expire after the first completed physical play/replay group or at turn end. X/negative canonical costs bypass local modifiers; Snecko skips X and negative effective costs before sampling.
rules.implementation: The existing turn_cost array is cleared after the completed play. Its serialized representation is retained. The cost getter preserves negative/X values; Touch of Insanity clears earlier temporary overrides.

rules.finding: Each applicable turn grants a fixed one extra card or energy and decrements one layer; layers extend duration.
rules.implementation: Existing duration representation retained; two-bottle regressions verify six turns of one extra benefit.

rules.finding: Adds one replay, decrements one layer per modified card play, and expires unused layers after the side turn.
rules.implementation: Existing next-N-cards behavior retained and covered by a two-bottle, three-card numerical regression.

rules.finding: Enumerates the current combat cards, filters the Strike tag, and increments each existing instance's BaseReplayCount. No generation listener is installed.
rules.implementation: Existing instance replay fields retained; a Strike created after use receives no retroactive replay.

rules.finding: Moves the hand into draw, shuffles draw and discard together, then draws five. Does not recover exhausted cards or installed powers.
rules.implementation: Equivalent pile membership is retained without discard triggers. Added an exhaust/power preservation and nested Stratagem-selection regression.

rules.rule: generated card pools and distinct batches
rules.finding: Attack/skill/power generation uses the owner's character pool and combat eligibility. Cosmic Concoction requests three distinct colorless models before upgrading and adding them.
rules.implementation: Shared generation filters apply the supported owner's pool. Generate flags retain free/upgraded low bits and encode an optional distinct batch count above them; Cosmic Concoction requests count 3, upgraded.

rules.finding: For players, grants current-amount block at side-turn end, then decrements at the next applicable side-turn start; the start-turn block branch excludes players.
rules.implementation: Removes the duplicate player-start block payment. Heart of Iron is tested against an actual enemy attack before the next player turn.

rules.rule: Fairy outside combat and fractional healing
rules.finding: Run-level death prevention includes carried potions without a combat state. Positive fractional resulting HP is truncated when stored, with Fairy ensuring at least 1 HP.
rules.implementation: The common revival path supports lethal event HP loss. Actual Baths/Vegetation event tests cover one-bottle consumption, continuation, nonlethal preservation and death without a bottle.
